definition: Relating to a pope or the highest church authority.
author: Miguel de Cervantes Saavedra
quote: Countless are they who, born of mean parentage, have risen to the highest dignities, pontifical and imperial, and of the truth of this I could give thee instances enough to weary thee.
example_sentence: He delivered his verdict on the curry with pontifical solemnity.
